name: LinkedIn Jobs
description: Best for established companies, direct recruiter messages, and 1-click Easy Apply roles.
tips: Filter by 'Past Week' and 'Easy Apply' to get faster recruiter responses.

name: Indeed
description: Massive volume across every industry, company size, and local market.
tips: Sort by 'Date' rather than 'Relevance' to catch listings posted in the last 48 hours.

name: Wellfound (AngelList)
description: Direct communication with startup founders and engineering leads. Transparent salary ranges and equity.
tips: Great for early-stage to Series B tech teams looking for hands-on builders.

name: RemoteOK
description: Curated remote engineering, product, and design roles from worldwide companies.
tips: Look for listings tagged with 'Worldwide' if applying from outside North America or Europe.

name: Google Jobs
description: Google's real-time job indexing engine pulling postings across thousands of company career portals.
tips: Pulls directly from GreenHouse, Lever, and Workday company career sites.

name: Y Combinator (Work at a Startup)
description: Exclusive job board for Y Combinator funded startups. Directly browse roles by batch, tech stack, and funding.
tips: Applications go straight to the founder's inbox without passing generic HR screening.

name: Glassdoor
description: Search job openings alongside verified anonymous employee reviews and real salary figures.
tips: Check interview review sections for recent candidates' question lists.

name: ZipRecruiter
description: High-speed matching with 'Applied' status tracking and 1-tap applications.
tips: Use the 'Urgent Hiring' filter to locate hiring managers making fast decisions.
